name: Local Concert Scout
tagline: Finds nearby shows matched to your Spotify or Apple Music taste
description: Surfaces concerts near you by matching lineups against what you actually stream on Spotify or Apple Music. Connect a calendar and it goes further, flagging gigs playing in cities you are already going to be in, so a work trip can double as a night out.
author: chaney_tx
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
